description: Killing parrots crashes your game. Note: I did kill other mobs and it isn t just swinging the sword and i got the same result everytime i killed a parrot. 19w40a: [^crash-2019-10-03_20.30.29-client.txt] Description: Unexpected error java.lang.NullPointerException: Unexpected error at atd.a(SourceFile:407) at axx.f(SourceFile:1234) at dmq.a(SourceFile:363) at das.aE(SourceFile:1234) at das.aG(SourceFile:1517) at das.n(SourceFile:1367) at das.d(SourceFile:907) at das.b(SourceFile:569) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:199)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 19w40a.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Summon a parrot using the command: `/summon minecraft:parrot ~ ~ ~`.
4. Attack the parrot using any melee weapon.
5. Observe that the game crashes with a `java.lang.NullPointerException`.
Observed Behavior:
Upon attacking a parrot in Minecraft version 19w40a, the game consistently crashes, resulting in a java.lang.NullPointerException. This crash occurs specifically when the player uses any form of attack on a parrot, regardless of the weapon or method employed. Notably, the issue persists even after successfully attacking and killing other mobs without incident, indicating that the problem is isolated to parrots.

The crash report generated during this event includes the following stack trace:

```
Description: Unexpected error
java.lang.NullPointerException: Unexpected error 
at atd.a(SourceFile:407) 
at axx.f(SourceFile:1234) 
at dmq.a(SourceFile:363) 
at das.aE(SourceFile:1234) 
at das.aG(SourceFile:1517) 
at das.n(SourceFile:1367) 
at das.d(SourceFile:907) 
at das.b(SourceFile:569) 
at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:199)
```

This indicates that the error arises from a null reference in the code related to the parrot entity. The consistent nature of the crash whenever a parrot is attacked suggests a critical bug that needs addressing, as it disrupts gameplay and prevents players from interacting with this specific mob. 

To reproduce the issue, players can attempt to attack a parrot in any biome or environment, leading to an immediate crash of the client. The crash occurs regardless of whether the parrot is in flight or on the ground, confirming that the bug is not dependent on the parrot's state. This behavior highlights a significant flaw in the game's handling of parrot interactions, warranting urgent attention from the development team.
Expected Behavior: When a player attacks a parrot, the game should process the action without any errors, allowing the player to successfully kill the parrot and receive any drops associated with it without crashing. Instead of encountering a java.lang.NullPointerException, the game should continue to function normally, enabling the player to interact with other game elements seamlessly after the action.
